description: You are an internal audit specialist at NorthBridge Financial Group. The Chief Audit Executive needs you to finalize the Q3 2024 Internal Audit Report (/home/ga/Documents/audit_draft.docx) before it is presented to the Audit Committee next week. The Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) standards and firm presentation requirements dictate the following format: (1) The 'Executive Summary' section must be enclosed in a bordered single-cell table that spans the full text width — place the heading 'Executive Summary' inside the table cell, followed by the summary paragraph text, all within one table cell with a visible border on all sides; (2) Each of the five audit findings must have its heading formatted with 'Heading 2' style and prefixed with 'Finding [N]: ' where N is 1 through 5 — so the headings become 'Finding 1: Access Control Deficiencies', 'Finding 2: Segregation of Duties Gaps', etc.; (3) The Risk Ratings Summary table (which lists all findings with their risk ratings) must have: a header row with bold text on a dark background (dark gray #404040 or similar), and the words 'High', 'Medium', and 'Low' in the Risk Rating column colored red, orange/amber, and green respectively; (4) A footer on every page containing 'Internal Audit Report — Q3 2024 | DRAFT' left-aligned and 'NorthBridge Financial Group' right-aligned; (5) The last page must contain a 'Report Sign-Off' section with a single-cell bordered table containing signature lines for 'Chief Audit Executive:', 'Date:', and 'Audit Committee Chair:'. Save the final document as /home/ga/Documents/audit_final.docx.
